title: Common-stage realization comparison descent
statement: Given a family I(E) of IntegralReindex maps for the normalized RingReindex B, there is a natural isomorphism from common-stage pullback followed by ordinary realization on T to ordinary realization on U followed by derived pullback along B, and it satisfies integralRealizationAgreement for every E.

source.place: BS Remark 6.8.15; HRS Lemma 7.9; explicit subargument of lem-sf-adic-reindexing-core, not a verbatim statement of either source.

proof.text: Given the balanced IntegralReindex family, compose the specified integral realization isomorphism with the inverse derived balanced comparison and inverse completion-unit comparison. The scalar-extension and finite-free comparison squares identify the components over common finite fields; naturality and inverse identities descend from integral representatives. This yields the common-stage natural isomorphism and integralRealizationAgreement for every E.

theorem exists_realization_comparison_descent (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u})
    (d : ∀ T : GeometricSpace D, SpaceData l D T)
    (T U : GeometricSpace D) (g : T.base.left ≅ U.base.left)
    (B : RingReindex l T.base.left g.hom (d T).realization (d U).realization)
    (I : ∀ E, IntegralReindex l T.base.left g.hom B E) :
    letI := (d T).units
    letI := (d U).units
    ∃ c : commonStageDerivedPullback l (PadicAlgCl l) g.hom ⋙
        ordinary l T.base.left (d T).realization ≅
      ordinary l U.base.left (d U).realization ⋙ derivedPull l T.base.left g.hom B,
    ∀ E, integralRealizationAgreement l g.hom (d T).realization (d U).realization
      B E (I E) c
